proposals.source: The target's fire resistance is reduced by %d%%, and the target is highly vulnerable to the flames of the fearscape. When the effect ends, the target will take %d fire damage. This damage will increase by %d%% of all damage taken while under torment
proposals.target: 目标的火焰抗性下降 %d%%，并且极易受到恶魔空间火焰的伤害。效果结束时将受到 %d 火焰伤害，该伤害还会增加效果期间所受总伤害的 %d%%。
proposals.notes: Gemini 3.8 Flash draft for M220; not applied.
